import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 1000000009L;
    
    static class Edge {
        int u, v, f, c;
        Edge(int u, int v, int f, int c) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }
    
    static int src, snk;
    static List<List<Integer>> g;
    static List<Edge> e;
    static int[] ptr;
    static int[] d;
    
    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        g.get(u).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
        g.get(v).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }
    
    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[src] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int id : g.get(u)) {
                Edge ed = e.get(id);
                if (d[ed.v] == -1 && ed.f < ed.c) {
                    d[ed.v] = d[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(ed.v);
                    if (ed.v == snk) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static long dfs(int u, long f) {
        if (u == snk || f == 0) return f;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); i++) {
            ptr[u] = i;
            int id = g.get(u).get(i);
            Edge ed = e.get(id);
            if (d[ed.v] != d[u] + 1) continue;
            long pushed = dfs(ed.v, Math.min(f, (long)ed.c - ed.f));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                ed.f += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).f -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static long maxFlow() {
        long flow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            long pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(src, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }
    
    static String[] sci = new String[101];
    static String[] rec = new String[101];
    static boolean[][][][] ok = new boolean[10][10][10][10];
    static int[][] seen = new int[101][101];
    static int[][] badAt = new int[10][10];
    static int R, C;
    
    static boolean inRange(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < R && c < C;
    }
    
    static int idx(int r, int c) {
        return 1 + C * r + c;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        ++T;
        C = R;
        snk = C * C * 2 + 1;
        src = 0;
        g = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < C * C * 2 + 2; i++) {
            g.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        e = new ArrayList<>();
        ptr = new int[1001];
        d = new int[1001];
        
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) {
            sci[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) {
            rec[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                badAt[i][j] = (int)INF;
                if (rec[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    badAt[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            for (int di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                for (int dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                    if (Math.abs(di) + Math.abs(dj) == 1) {
                        int nx = x + di;
                        int ny = y + dj;
                        if (inRange(nx, ny) && badAt[nx][ny] == INF && sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                            badAt[nx][ny] = badAt[x][y] + 1;
                            q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < R; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < C; y++) {
                char ch = sci[x].charAt(y);
                if (ch >= '1' && ch <= '9') {
                    addEdge(src, idx(x, y), ch - '0');
                }
                ch = rec[x].charAt(y);
                if (ch >= '1' && ch <= '9') {
                    addEdge(R * R + idx(x, y), snk, ch - '0');
                }
                for (int X = 0; X < R; X++) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < C; Y++) {
                        if (sci[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || sci[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' ||
                            rec[X].charAt(Y) == 'Y' || rec[X].charAt(Y) == 'Z') {
                            continue;
                        }
                        for (int i = 0; i <= R; i++) {
                            Arrays.fill(seen[i], 0);
                        }
                        Queue<int[]> bq = new LinkedList<>();
                        bq.offer(new int[]{x, y, 1});
                        seen[x][y] = 1;
                        boolean found = false;
                        while (!bq.isEmpty()) {
                            int[] cell = bq.poll();
                            int cx = cell[0];
                            int cy = cell[1];
                            int t = cell[2];
                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                seen[cx][cy] = 1;
                                found = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (t >= badAt[cx][cy] || t >= T) continue;
                            for (int di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                                for (int dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                                    if (Math.abs(di) + Math.abs(dj) == 1) {
                                        int nx = cx + di;
                                        int ny = cy + dj;
                                        if (inRange(nx, ny) && seen[nx][ny] == 0 &&
                                            sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && sci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Z' &&
                                            t + 1 <= badAt[nx][ny]) {
                                            seen[nx][ny] = 1;
                                            bq.offer(new int[]{nx, ny, t + 1});
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (found) {
                            addEdge(idx(x, y), R * R + idx(X, Y), (int)INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxFlow());
    }
}
